title: QoS ticket: policy exists, behavior does not change
summary: Find and repair the missing edge policy attachment from configuration evidence.
brief: Voice traffic is classified and marked in EDGE-QOS, but the expected marking behavior is not taking effect at the Ethernet1 edge. Inspect the configured policy and the interface configuration before making the smallest repair. Attach the existing policy in the correct direction. This configuration-only ticket cannot generate traffic or counters, so it grades the local attachment and your evidence collection rather than claimed traffic behavior.
hints: Start with show policy-map to confirm that the policy itself exists.
Then use running configuration to find where (or whether) it is attached.
Use the existing EDGE-QOS policy; do not rebuild classification or marking.

checks.label: EDGE-QOS is attached input on Ethernet1
